name: Portrait Beat Montage
summary: Builds an editable 16.3-second 3:4 portrait montage Draft from 10 person clips: a monochrome strobe intro, beat-timed cuts that enter on a person-only zigzag smear with a warm flash, and a white glow ending, cut to the bundled soundtrack.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Windows needs Selects 2.0.512 or later; its person mattes use Selects generation credits. Released-version compatibility is unverified.

de.name: Portrait Beat Montage
de.summary: Erstellt aus 10 Personenclips einen bearbeitbaren, 16,3 Sekunden langen 3:4-Hochformat-Zusammenschnitt als Draft: ein monochromes Stroboskop-Intro, beatgenaue Schnitte, die mit einem nur auf die Person wirkenden Zickzack-Schmier und einem warmen Blitz einsetzen, und ein weißes Glow-Ende, geschnitten auf den mitgelieferten Soundtrack.

en.name: Portrait Beat Montage
en.summary: Builds an editable 16.3-second 3:4 portrait montage Draft from 10 person clips: a monochrome strobe intro, beat-timed cuts that enter on a person-only zigzag smear with a warm flash, and a white glow ending, cut to the bundled soundtrack.

es.name: Portrait Beat Montage
es.summary: Crea un Draft de montaje vertical 3:4 editable de 16,3 segundos a partir de 10 clips de personas: una intro estroboscópica monocroma, cortes al ritmo que entran con un barrido en zigzag aplicado solo a la persona y un destello cálido, y un final con resplandor blanco, montado sobre la banda sonora incluida.

fr.name: Portrait Beat Montage
fr.summary: Crée un Draft de montage vertical 3:4 modifiable de 16,3 secondes à partir de 10 plans de personnes : une intro stroboscopique monochrome, des coupes calées sur le rythme qui entrent par un filé en zigzag appliqué à la seule personne avec un flash chaud, et une fin en halo blanc, monté sur la bande-son fournie.

it.name: Portrait Beat Montage
it.summary: Crea un Draft di montaggio verticale 3:4 modificabile di 16,3 secondi da 10 clip di persone: un'introduzione stroboscopica monocroma, stacchi a tempo che entrano con una sbavatura a zigzag applicata alla sola persona e un flash caldo, e un finale con bagliore bianco, montato sulla colonna sonora inclusa.

ja.name: Portrait Beat Montage
ja.summary: 人物が写った10本のクリップから、16.3秒の3:4縦型モンタージュを編集可能なDraftとして作成します。モノクロのストロボイントロ、人物だけがジグザグに流れるスメアと暖色のフラッシュで入るビートカット、白いグローで終わる構成で、付属のサウンドトラックに合わせてカットします。

ko.name: Portrait Beat Montage
ko.summary: 인물이 나오는 클립 10개로 16.3초 3:4 세로 모타주를 수정 가능한 Draft로 만듭니다. 흑백 스트로브 인트로로 시작해, 인물만 지그재그로 번지는 스메어와 따뜻한 플래시로 들어오는 비트 컷을 거쳐 흰 글로우로 끝나며, 내장 음원에 맞추어 컷합니다.

pt.name: Portrait Beat Montage
pt.summary: Cria um Draft de montagem vertical 3:4 editável de 16,3 segundos a partir de 10 clipes de pessoas: uma introdução estroboscópica monocromática, cortes no ritmo que entram com um borrão em ziguezague aplicado apenas à pessoa e um flash quente, e um final com brilho branco, montado na trilha sonora incluída.

tr.name: Portrait Beat Montage
tr.summary: İnsan görünen 10 klipten düzenlenebilir 16,3 saniyelik 3:4 dikey montaj Draft'ı oluşturur: tek renkli bir stroboskop girişi, yalnızca kişiye uygulanan zikzak bulanıklık ve sıcak bir parıltıyla giren ritme kilitli kesmeler ve beyaz bir parıltıyla biten final; pakete dahil müziğe göre kurgulanır.

zh.name: Portrait Beat Montage
zh.summary: 从 10 段人物素材生成可编辑的 16.3 秒 3:4 竖版人像混剪 Draft：黑白频闪开场，每个镜头随节拍切入并带有仅作用于人物的锯齿拖影和暖色闪光，结尾为白色光晕，按插件自带的配乐切点。

inputs.label: Select 10 videos
inputs.hint: One person per clip, from the face to the chest. The first five come back after the tenth.

prepare: One person per clip, framed from the face to the chest
macOS (Apple silicon): a one-time person-matte setup, a download of a few hundred MB
Windows: no setup; the person mattes use Selects generation credits
